rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: Chargeback Velocity Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies serial chargeback abusers across multiple merchants")`
index=flame_payments sourcetype=flame:dispute_management
  (dispute_type="chargeback" OR dispute_type="pre-arbitration")
| lookup delivery_lookup original_transaction_id OUTPUT delivery_confirmed, delivery_date
| where delivery_confirmed="true"
| stats count AS dispute_count,
        dc(merchant_id) AS merchant_count,
        sum(dispute_amount) AS total_disputed,
        min(dispute_date) AS first_dispute,
        max(dispute_date) AS last_dispute,
        values(dispute_reason_code) AS reason_codes
  BY cardholder_id, cardholder_name
| where dispute_count >= 3 AND merchant_count >= 2
| eval dispute_window_days = round((strptime(last_dispute, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_dispute, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| sort - dispute_count
rules.title: DL-0190: Chargeback Velocity Pattern — Serial Dispute Filing Across Merchants with Confirmed Delivery (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL: First-Party Dispute Anomaly Detection")`
`comment("Triple-correlated friendly fraud: delivery + device match + no merchant contact")`
index=flame_payments sourcetype=flame:dispute_management
  dispute_type="chargeback"
| lookup delivery_lookup original_transaction_id
    OUTPUT delivery_confirmed, delivery_date
| lookup device_lookup original_transaction_id
    OUTPUT purchase_device_fingerprint
| lookup merchant_contact_lookup cardholder_id, merchant_id
    OUTPUT merchant_contact_prior
| where delivery_confirmed="true"
  AND dispute_device_fingerprint=purchase_device_fingerprint
  AND (merchant_contact_prior="false" OR isnull(merchant_contact_prior))
| eval days_delivery_to_dispute = round(
    (strptime(dispute_date, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(delivery_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| table dispute_id, cardholder_id, merchant_id, dispute_amount,
        dispute_reason_code, dispute_date, delivery_date,
        days_delivery_to_dispute, purchase_device_fingerprint
| sort - dispute_amount
rules.title: DL-0191: First-Party Dispute Anomaly — Chargeback with Delivery Confirmation, Device Match, and No Merchant Contact (SPLUNK)
